tool_schemas.name: get-workouts
tool_schemas.description: Lists workouts for the authenticated account, ordered newest to oldest, and returns up to `limit` items plus an opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page; you can filter by `started_after`, `started_before`, and `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is outside 1–100, timestamps are not valid RFC3339 date-times, or `started_after` is after `started_before`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of workouts to return (newest to oldest).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

started_after.description: Only include workouts started after this timestamp.

started_before.description: Only include workouts started before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get-workout
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workout by either `workout_id` (hv_wkt_… ULID) or `hevy_workout_id` and returns the full workout record including exercises and sets. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, both are provided, or `workout_id` does not match the required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if no workout exists for the given identifier, UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-workout-count
tool_schemas.description: Returns the total count of workouts matching the optional `started_after`, `started_before`, and `status` filters (useful for stats and planning pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if timestamps are not valid RFC3339 date-times or `started_after` is after `started_before`. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

started_after.description: Only count workouts started after this timestamp.

started_before.description: Only count workouts started before this timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get-workout-events
tool_schemas.description: Lists workout change events (created/updated/deleted) with `effective_at` on/after `since`, ordered newest to oldest, returning up to `limit` events plus an opaque `cursor` for the next page; optionally filter by `event_type`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `since` is missing/invalid, `limit` is outside 1–200, or `event_type` is not one of the supported values. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

since.description: Return events with effective_at on/after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (newest to oldest).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of events.

tool_schemas.name: create-workout
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new workout for the authenticated account and returns the complete created workout (including its assigned `workout_id`) with all exercises and sets as stored. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, `title` is empty, `exercises` is empty, any exercise has no `sets`, any numeric field violates its min/max constraints (e.g., negative `weight`/`duration_seconds` or `rpe` outside 0–10), or any provided template id does not match its required pattern. Raises NOT_FOUND if a referenced `exercise_template_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

exercises.description: Exercises performed in the workout, including their sets.

exercise_template_id.description: Internal exercise template id (hv_ext_... ULID) used for this exercise.

hevy_exercise_template_id.description: Upstream Hevy exercise template identifier (if known).

title.description: Exercise name/title as shown in the workout.

set_index.description: Zero-based set position within the exercise.

weight.description: Weight used for the set (unit as tracked by the account/workout).

duration_seconds.description: Set duration in seconds (for timed/cardio/bodyweight sets).

distance.description: Distance for the set (for cardio), if applicable.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion (0-10), if tracked.

tool_schemas.name: update-workout
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing workout identified by `workout_id` and returns the full updated workout; when `exercises` is provided it replaces the workout’s existing exercise/set list with the new list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workout_id` is missing/invalid, any provided field fails validation (e.g., empty `title`, invalid timestamps, negative numeric values, `rpe` outside 0–10), or an `exercises` array is provided but is empty or contains exercises without `sets`. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `workout_id` does not exist (or a referenced `exercise_template_id` does not exist), UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workout_id.description: Internal workout id (hv_wkt_... ULID) to update.

exercises.description: Updated full exercise list (replaces existing exercises and sets).

exercise_template_id.description: Internal exercise template id (hv_ext_... ULID) used for this exercise.

hevy_exercise_template_id.description: Upstream Hevy exercise template identifier (if known).

title.description: Exercise name/title as shown in the workout.

set_index.description: Zero-based set position within the exercise.

weight.description: Weight used for the set (unit as tracked by the account/workout).

duration_seconds.description: Set duration in seconds (for timed/cardio/bodyweight sets).

distance.description: Distance for the set (for cardio), if applicable.

rpe.description: Rate of perceived exertion (0-10), if tracked.

tool_schemas.name: get-routines
tool_schemas.description: Lists routines for the authenticated account and returns up to `limit` items plus an opaque `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is outside 1–100 or `cursor` is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of routines to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

folder_id.description: Filter routines by internal folder id (hv_rfd_... ULID).

is_default.description: If provided, filter to default (true) or custom (false) routines.

tool_schemas.name: get-routine
tool_schemas.description: get-routines Get a paginated list of routines. Returns routine details including title, creation date, folder assignment, and exercise configurations. Results include both default and custom routines.

tool_schemas.name: create-routine
tool_schemas.description: Create a new workout routine in your Hevy account. Requires title and at least one exercise with sets. Optionally assign to a specific folder. Returns the complete routine details upon successful creation including the newly assigned routine ID.

folder_id.description: Optional routine folder ID to assign the routine to.

is_default.description: Whether this routine should be marked as a default routine.

exercise_configs.description: Routine exercise configuration list (must include at least one exercise and each exercise must include at least one set).

exercise_template_id.description: Exercise template ID to use for this routine exercise.

title.description: Optional override name shown for this exercise in the routine.

notes.description: Optional notes for this exercise in the routine.

sets.description: Planned sets for this routine exercise (at least one).

duration_seconds.description: Planned duration in seconds for timed sets.

rpe.description: Optional RPE/RIR intensity target for the set.

tool_schemas.name: update-routine
tool_schemas.description: Update an existing workout routine by ID. You can modify the title, notes, and exercise data. Returns the updated routine with all changes applied. Note that you cannot change the folder assignment through this method.

is_default.description: Whether this routine should be marked as a default routine.

exercise_configs.description: Full replacement of routine exercise configuration list (include at least one exercise and each exercise must include at least one set).

exercise_template_id.description: Exercise template ID to use for this routine exercise.

title.description: Optional override name shown for this exercise in the routine.

notes.description: Optional notes for this exercise in the routine.

sets.description: Planned sets for this routine exercise (at least one).

duration_seconds.description: Planned duration in seconds for timed sets.

rpe.description: Optional RPE/RIR intensity target for the set.

tool_schemas.name: get-exercise-templates
tool_schemas.description: Lists exercise templates visible to the authenticated account (default and/or custom) and returns a paginated page of templates with their metadata; pagination uses an opaque cursor and you can request up to 100 items via limit, with the response including the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit is outside 1–100, cursor is malformed, or any filter/sort/order value is not one of the allowed enums. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the account’s templates.

limit.description: Maximum number of exercise templates to return (max 100).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

is_default.description: Filter to only default templates (true) or only custom templates (false).

tool_schemas.name: get-exercise-template
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single exercise template by exercise_template_id and returns its full template details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if exercise_template_id does not match the required hv_ext_… format. Raises NOT_FOUND if no exercise template with that ID is visible to the authenticated account, UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, and FORBIDDEN if access to that template is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: get-routine-folders
tool_schemas.description: Lists routine folders on the authenticated account and returns a paginated page of folders (including id, title, index, and timestamps); pagination uses an opaque cursor and you can request up to 100 items via limit, with the response including the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when limit is outside 1–100, cursor is malformed, or any status/sort/order value is not one of the allowed enums. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the account’s routine folders.

limit.description: Maximum number of routine folders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-routine-folder
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single routine folder by folder_id and returns the folder details including id, title, index, and timestamps. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if folder_id does not match the required hv_rfd_… format. Raises NOT_FOUND if the folder does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated account, UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated, and FORBIDDEN if access to that folder is not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: create-routine-folder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new routine folder for the authenticated account and returns the newly created folder (including its assigned id, index, and timestamps); the new folder is inserted at index 0 and existing folders are shifted down by incrementing their indexes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title is missing or not a string in the request body. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not authenticated and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to create folders on the account.

tool_schemas.name: update-workout-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a workout lifecycle state for the authenticated account by locating it via `hevy_workout_id` and updating its `status`. Supports soft-deleting a workout (status=deleted) and appends a corresponding workout_events row (event_type='deleted', effective_at=now()). Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported transitions, NOT_FOUND if no workout matches, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when daily quotas are exceeded.

hevy_workout_id.description: Upstream Hevy workout identifier for the workout to update.

status.description: Target lifecycle status transition for the workout.

tool_schemas.name: update-routine-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a routine lifecycle state for the authenticated account by id, returning the updated routine. Supports archiving/unarchiving and soft-deleting; refuses invalid transitions. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for bad ids/status, NOT_FOUND if the routine does not exist for the account, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when daily quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update-routine-folder-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a routine folder lifecycle state for the authenticated account by id (soft-delete only). Returns the updated folder. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported transitions, NOT_FOUND if the folder does not exist for the account, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when daily quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update-exercise-template-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an exercise template lifecycle state for the authenticated account by id (soft-delete only). Returns the updated template. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for unsupported transitions, NOT_FOUND if the template does not exist for the account, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when daily quotas are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update-account-status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the authenticated account lifecycle state. This is primarily used by the caller to revoke its own token (status=revoked) or to re-activate a suspended account where permitted. Refuses FORBIDDEN when attempting an unsupported transition (e.g., revoked -> active), UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid credentials, and RATE_LIMITED when daily quotas are exceeded.

metadata.name: Hevy Fitness API MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores a Hevy user's workout history (workouts, exercises, sets) plus reusable planning artifacts (routines, routine folders, and exercise templates). Primary workflows are: listing/counting workouts, creating/updating workouts, syncing changes via workout events, and managing routines/
